map.闻诊包括听声音和嗅气味两方面，通过异常声音与气味辨识病证（基于《中医闻诊》内容）: Auscultation and olfaction cover both listening to sound and smelling odours, identifying patterns from abnormal sounds and smells (based on the content of TCM Auscultation and Olfaction)
map.闻诊以听声音、嗅气味辨病性：语声高亢有力多属实证、低沉无力多属虚证；喘促气粗为实: Auscultation and olfaction identify the nature of illness from sound and smell: a loud, forceful voice usually indicates excess syndrome while a low, weak voice indicates deficiency; coarse rapid breathing indicates excess while low short breathing indicates deficiency; foul breath usually indicates stomach heat and sour putrid breath indicates food stagnation; a heavy turbid cough sound indicates wind-cold while a dry cough with little phlegm indicates dryness or yin deficiency. Abnormal features are classified by excess, deficiency, cold and heat, outputting pattern hints.
